Chapter 634: Chapter 46 Galaxy Master No Matter How Strong, Can’t Possibly Wipe Us All Out? (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

Long before Lin Yuan demonstrated his absolute strength and killed Hunyi, the strongest of the Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank, the Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization, led by Duoke, had been scheming to eradicate other hostile Ninth Rank Alien Races.

After all, such an opportunity is rare, being in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, where higher levels of combat power cannot interfere, and on the human side, there was Lin Yuan, such a freak of nature.

The opportunity naturally had to be seized.

“Those Ninth Rank Different Species probably won’t be resigned to capture,” Lin Yuan surmised in his heart.

The eradication plans of the Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization naturally intended to completely settle scores with those hostile Different Species, or at the very least drive them into the inner regions, waiting for the end of the Secret Realm’s opening period.

Any Ninth Rank Alien Race that is not located in the outer region will be ‘erased’ by the Secret Realm.

...

While the lives in the outer region will be expelled by the Secret Realm itself.

Therefore—

For those hostile Ninth Rank Alien Races, even if they do not wish to confront Lin Yuan, they will definitely rise to resist, since death is the end result either way.

“It’s just unknown whether they will commit more effort…” Lin Yuan estimated in his mind.

The Ninth Rank Evolvers on the side of human civilization surely had some inkling of the plans, and those Ninth Rank Alien Races must have noticed.

Since they could notice, they would certainly have countermeasures.

The Ninth Rank powerhouses who enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm can only leave after a hundred years when the Secret Realm closes.

But in the meantime, the powerhouses outside can still enter, and by communicating with those Ninth Rank powerhouses inside the Secret Realm, they can completely bring in some Special Treasures.

Or they could simply invite some powerful special Ninth Rank allies for support.

Every time the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opens, it indeed attracts a large number of Ninth Rank lives to enter, but not every Ninth Rank powerhouse will participate.

…

Virtual World.

Personal Space.

Dozens of human Ninth Rank Myriad Heavy Realm Evolvers all gathered here.

“The Galaxy Master has arrived.”

“Galaxy Master,” dozens of Ninth Rank Myriad Heavy Realm Evolvers all got up and looked towards a young man who appeared out of thin air.

Galaxy Master.

Among the many Ninth Rank powerhouses on the scene, who wasn’t a domineering figure in their own right—even on the Large Alien Battlefield, they are not considered weak, and some special Ninth Ranks even have a good chance of advancing to the Tenth Rank.

But now, put all of them together, or even all the Ninth Rank Evolvers of this generation of human civilization.

In the presence of the Galaxy Master.

They all seemed to fade into insignificance.

“Galaxy Master,” Duoke greeted Lin Yuan with a nod.

Before Lin Yuan, he was the strongest Ninth Rank of this era in human civilization, having opened up nearly forty million Spatial Layers.

But now, the title of strongest Ninth Rank of human civilization naturally fell upon the Galaxy Master. Had it been anyone else, Duoke might have felt some discontent.

But the Galaxy Master?

Having watched the ‘video footage’ of the Galaxy Master killing Hunyi, how could Duoke dare to harbour any feelings of discontent?

“Please, take your seats,” Lin Yuan said with a smile, casually taking the main seat.

“Galaxy Master, the seal around the outer region of the Secret Realm is now almost formed. Next, we may face the backlash from those Ninth Rank Alien Races,” Duoke immediately said, “At that time, we will need the Galaxy Master to take action, otherwise we wouldn’t be able to hold against those Ninth Rank Alien Races.”

“`

Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization laid down a blockade on the outer area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, those Ninth Rank Alien Races didn’t dare to rebel.

What was the reason?

It was nothing but the fear of the Galaxy Master, who could appear at any moment.

Thus, those Ninth Rank Alien Races could only flee and hide, over and over again.

However, the outer area was the smallest region of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. No matter how much they fled, they would eventually be driven into a corner.

That would also be the moment when all Ninth Rank Alien Races would rise in rebellion.

Among these Ninth Rank Alien Races were members of the Insect Race Alliance, the Tianyu Clan Alliance, and so on; if they were not wary of the Galaxy Master, they would have already torn through the blockade set by human civilization.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Eliminating those Ninth Rank Alien Races had always been Lin Yuan’s intention, not to mention that in this encirclement, he would be able to obtain ninety percent of the profits.

“Then, we will trouble the Galaxy Master at that time,” Duoke said with a smile surfacing on his face.

“I wonder which area the Galaxy Master is in right now?” Duoke seemed to think of something and tentatively asked.

“I am in the outer area, ready to strike at any moment,” Lin Yuan said casually.

In truth, he was still in the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but with Lin Yuan’s current control over the Secret Realm, he could appear in any location within it in a mere thought.

So saying “ready to strike at any moment” was not a boast.

“That’s good.”

“With the Galaxy Master here, those alien races had better just wait for their demise.”

“Hahahaha, I have never felt so thrilled. Thank you, Galaxy Master.”

Each of the Ninth Rank Evolvers was in high spirits.

In the past, whenever the secret realm opened, the Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization would avoid the Ninth Rank Alien Races as much as possible, because fighting to the death inside the secret realm was meaningless; the most important thing was to take the spoils out.

But now, the Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization were actively hunting down those Ninth Rank Alien Races.

Although these Ninth Rank Alien Races did not represent the full strength of their factions and were only avatars, morale was being boosted.

…

Elsewhere.

In a dark space.

Hundreds of wills descended. Human civilization had the Virtual World, allowing all Evolvers to communicate and interact in real time.

While other Different Species were unable to build a Virtual World like that of human civilization, they had created a space for temporary information exchange.

And the hundreds of wills that descended here were those of the Ninth Rank Alien Races present in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

These alien races came from major groups and were basically the strong enemies of human civilization,

As for those Ninth Rank Alien Races that didn’t have significant conflicts with human civilization, as well as some solitary and unique lifeforms at the ninth rank, they were not within the scope of human civilization’s current encirclement.

Compared to the laughter and cheerful voices on the side of human civilization, the atmosphere here seemed somewhat lifeless.

All the Ninth Rank Alien Races were filled with fear; they had all seen the ‘video’ of the Galaxy Master killing Hunyi, and they didn’t believe they had any chance of winning against the Galaxy Master.

“What are you all worried about?”

“Even if that Galaxy Master is very powerful, could he really kill us all?”

After a long time, a leading figure furrowed his brow and looked around as he spoke.
